title: PHP 7.1.0 Released
content:
The PHP development team announces the immediate availability of PHP 7.1.0. This release is the first point release in the 7.x series.

PHP 7.1.0 comes with numerous improvements and new features such as

For source downloads of PHP 7.1.0 please visit our page, Windows binaries can be found on the site. The list of changes is recorded in the .downloadsPHP for WindowsChangeLog
